verdicts.evidence: The page gives no clock times. Paragraph 1 says "every forty minutes between early morning and late evening", paragraph 3 says "the last crossing leaves the quay before dusk", and the page ends with "Printed timetables are kept in the shelter at each landing."

The page has three plain paragraphs with no labels (times and crossing, bicycles, winter), and paragraph 1's second sentence is long (about 43 words) and ends on the crew's wider course around the sandbank by the harbour wall.
